{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.56

|arg= global

|gr1= Artillery

|descr= Returns ETA to the target in seconds for given artillery unit based on target position and used magazine, -1 if target can't be hit.

|s1= unit [[getArtilleryETA]] [targetPosition, magazineType]

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - artillery unit

|p2= targetPosition: [[Position#PositionAGLS|PositionAGLS]] - position of the target

|p3= magazineType: [[String]] - type of magazine used

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>_mortar getArtilleryETA [getPos _target, getArtilleryAmmo [_mortar] select 0];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_mortar getArtilleryETA [position _target, currentMagazine _mortar];</sqf>

|seealso= [[getArtilleryAmmo]] [[commandArtilleryFire]] [[doArtilleryFire]] [[enableEngineArtillery]] [[getArtilleryComputerSettings]] [[shownArtilleryComputer]] [[inRangeOfArtillery]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Killzone_Kid
|timestamp= 20130826010000
|text= To avoid wrong ETA readings, position of the target should only be obtained via [[position]] or [[getPos]]
}}
